name: Xal
source:
As the youngest Sovereign, no one expects anything from Xal, not even himself. He is seen as a good-for-nothing and a poor excuse of a god, but you two are about to prove everyone wrong. For better or worse, he's the only one who can help you, but what if Xal needs you as much as you need him?

[From [url=https://ravenstar-games.itch.io/lost-in-limbo]itch.io[/url]]
